text_block_list.text:
In addition to her daily training and
social media
activity, Каррен Тян is also
making preparations
for the Cutie ♪
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As a result, she's extremely overworked,
causing
everyone around her to worry
for her health,
myself included.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Каррен Тян pleads with me to
let her
finish what she started. Her trust
in me pays off,
and I allow her to tackle
the workload alone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, she succeeds at getting
past the
worst of it and runs with a smile
once more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
